card.name: Linking words before chemotherapy or radiation
card.fires_on: Small linking words such as of, with, to, by, from or receiving that sit right before a word like chemotherapy, radiation or radiotherapy in cancer-treatment text.

modes.label: Cycle or prior-to wording
modes.description: Words like of or to after cycle or prior, where chemotherapy or radiotherapy comes next.
modes.example: greater than or equal to three cycles<< of>> chemotherapy, or a prior progenitor cell

modes.label: Combination wording
modes.description: With, in conjunction with, or in combination with, followed by chemotherapy or radiotherapy.
modes.example: associated with the use of filgrastim products in conjunction<< with>> chemotherapy and/or radiotherapy in patients with

modes.label: Receiving or caused by treatment
modes.description: Words like receiving or from that lead into radiation or radiotherapy.
modes.example: squamous cell carcinoma of the head and neck<< receiving>> radiation therapy randomized to darbepo
